notes.title: Update v1.1 - Bug fix and sound
notes.content:
[b]Update v1.1 - Bug fix and sound[/b]

1. Fixed "exit" button in games
2. correction of the bug on the number of kills in TDM
3. Addition of different bomb blasting effect
4. Improvement in the explosion sound of bombs
5. Adding a sound when taking a powerup
6. Say goodbye to Santa Claus from the back of the shed. Say hello to the famous gladiator.

Good games to you!
Studio Inward
